description: All four horsemen, unambiguous. Positive control for module 20.
transcript:
A: You never think about anyone but yourself. You are so selfish.
B: What about when you forgot my birthday? I was just trying to help.
A: Oh please. You are pathetic. Of course you would bring that up.
B: I'm not doing this.
A: So that is your answer? Every single time you walk away.
B: Whatever.
A: You are such a coward.
B: Fine.

gold.notes: Criticism: global quantifiers and trait nouns throughout. Contempt: 'pathetic', 'of course you would'. Stonewalling: explicit refusal plus two minimal turns.
